data.title: Reminder of dental cleaning appointment
data.summary: Zahnarztpraxis Beispielweiß reminds Bastian Musterquell of his professional dental cleaning (Zahnreinigung) appointment on Monday, 14 December 2026 at 16:15, lasting about one hour, and asks him to cancel at least two business days in advance if he cannot attend.
data.explanation: This is a routine reminder from your dentist about an upcoming professional teeth cleaning appointment. Make sure to show up at the stated time. If something comes up and you cannot make it, call or write to cancel at least two business days beforehand so the slot can be given to another patient; there is no fine mentioned, but late cancellations may be inconvenient for the practice. Note that the phone line will be down for maintenance on 18 December 2026, so written requests may take a little longer that day.

items.title: Cancel in good time if unable to attend
items.action: If you cannot make the appointment, cancel at least two business days (Werktage) beforehand
items.consequence: The practice cannot give the slot to another patient if you cancel late or not at all
items.quote: Wenn Sie verhindert sind, sagen Sie bitte mindestens zwei Werktage vorher ab, damit wir den Termin anderweitig vergeben können.
